name: gow3-local
description: Local marketplace of the FrosttyS18/gow3_pc fork: deterministic safety and audit harness for ZCode agents.

plugins.name: gow3-dev-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic guardrails for gow3_pc: blocks destructive git/shell operations, direct main changes, writes to the game engine (runtime, shadPS4, patch whitelist, scripts) and proprietary game files; validates the GOW3 ZCODE FINAL REPORT on Stop; injects session context on SessionStart.
